instruction: Shoot the bald man behind the office window, partially obscured by the people in front of him.
instruction_en: Shoot the bald man behind the office window, partially obscured by the people in front of him.

provenance.promotion: User-requested replacement of three reviewed previews

source_details.additionalCaptures: Native captures 20–42 and 45–51 accepted after CP4 retries. Total registered: 41. Failed-transition frames 43–44 rejected. Composite keeps the established background sources through 38 plus canonical 51; intermediate framing trials are not layered into the visible scene.
source_details.optics: Division radial rectification followed by pairwise homography graph registration across overlapping zoom/pan frames. Calibration-line fit RMS 7.014 to 1.549 pixels (fit metric, not independent global validation). CPU inverse-mapped bilinear projection avoids triangle raster seams.
source_details.singlePoseRegion: core.mjs GROUP_PATCH: central ally, hostage and bald target remain one intact observation. Native face at [545,429] is inside the clearer lens area instead of frame 42's blurred upper periphery. Feather only outer background border; GROUP_HUD_MASK removes the printed range number in background above the ally, never crossing a person. TARGET_SOURCE reannotated in frame 51.
source_details.targetAnnotation: core.mjs TARGET_SOURCE, manually reviewed visible head and upper torso; excludes foreground ally and hostage
source_details.sceneGeneration: CPU canvas screenshot registration and compositing. No generated NPCs, no placed game camera, no AI-generated imagery.
source_details.backgroundRepair: Playable crop is restricted to the observed region. Browser test reports zero missing background pixels before repair, so no gap interpolation is used in this version. Resampling/alpha blending still apply. Foreground window geometry comes from the wide reference to avoid mixing near/far depth planes; interior detail comes from the canonical close frame.
source_details.openingView: Actual pre-LT frame from original task video: static-tasks/sniper/GTA_TASK_008074_SEGMENT_032/source/initial_before_lt.jpg, 393.667 seconds. Independent observation; right mouse switches to the new native capture composite. No claim of same capture time or continuous transition.
limitations: Static image plane, bounded mouse look, no parallax or live NPC motion.
Samples were not simultaneous; one HUD-free canonical region now fixes the complete central character group. More distant/background characters are not guaranteed to share this exact timestamp.
Some background seams remain; not a benchmark-quality promotion.
Scope magnifications are preview controls, not measured original-game optical settings.
Frames 17, 43 and 44 entered a native failure transition and are excluded completely. Native CP4 was retried before captures 45–51.
Original captures remain local. Redistribution rights are not established.
source_details.verification: node tests/gameplay-sniper-preview.mjs: 41 source hashes, 30 scoring probes across 6 zoom levels, central group pixel-ownership check against frame 51, zero missing-source pixels in playable crop, right mouse and scroll browser events, original opening-frame pixel comparison, proxy-prefix routing, no HTTP/page errors

provenance.scoring: Original single-shot evaluator and GUI protocol; visible screenshot target polygon updated to match preview. Unscoped shots retain original failure semantics.
provenance.usage: Local captured-scene evaluation; redistribution rights not established.
